'''Watered Silk''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. During thier duel over ''[[Callandor]]'' in the [[Stone of Tear]], either [[Rand al'Thor]] or [[Be'lal]] used this form to counter [[The Falling Leaf]].{{ref/book|3|55}}
